How it works

How our dog poop pickup works.

Here is what we do every time we come. Six easy steps.

Questions

Ask us anything.

These are the questions neighbors text us most. Tap one to see our answer.

[[bf:What is the Black Friday sale?||Is my first cleanup free?]]

[[bf:Sign up by November 30 and your first month is free. The sale ends at midnight on November 30. Keep your plan for 60 days and your free month stays free. If you cancel in your first 60 days, we charge one month at your plan price, minus anything you have paid.||Yes. Your first cleanup is free when you sign up.]]

How much does it cost?

Weekly pickup is $108 a month for 1 or 2 dogs. That is about $25 a visit. [[bf:Black Friday sale: sign up by November 30 and your first month is free.||Your first cleanup is free.]]

Is the spray really free?

Yes. At every visit, we spray deodorizer on the spots your dogs use most. It costs you nothing.

Do you come in the summer heat?

Yes. In summer we start early, so your yard is done before the worst heat of the day.

What if it storms?

Light rain is fine. If there is lightning, we wait until it is safe. We text you if your time changes.

Do you clean artificial turf?

Yes. We pick up every pile and spray the spots your dogs use most. Turf can smell in the heat. For a deep clean, add a turf odor treatment for $35.

Where does the poop go?

We bag it, tie it shut and put it in your trash can.

Do you background check your team?

Yes. Every team member must pass a background check before they work in a yard. Your safety and our safety come first.

Are you bonded and insured?

Yes. We carry a $50,000 business service bond and $1,000,000 in general liability insurance.[[ins: Our insurance policy starts November 16, 2026.||]] See the proof on our bonded and insured page.

Do you clean your tools?

Yes. We clean our boots and tools after every yard. That keeps germs from going from yard to yard.

Can I pick my day?

No. We set your day for you. We run set routes, and that keeps our prices down. After you sign up, we reach out to let you know your day and time. Then you get a text the night before each visit with a 30 minute window.

Can you come today? We have a party.

Yes. Text us and we can come the same day for $49. It goes on your next bill on the 1st.

When do you charge my card?

On the 1st of each month.[[bf: With the Black Friday sale, your first month is free. Your first charge only covers the days after your free month, so it is smaller. Then you pay the full price on the 1st of each month.||]]

Who sees my gate code?

Only your scooper, and only on your day. You add it after you sign up. If you cancel, we delete it.

What if a dog in the yard is not safe to be near?

We don’t go in. We text you to bring the dog inside. We can come back the same day.

Can I skip a week?

Yes. You get 4 free skips a year. Sign in to My Yard and tap Skip next to the visit, up to 24 hours before. No phone call.

Can I pause while we are away?

Yes. After your first 60 days, you can pause for up to 120 days in My Yard. You don’t pay while you are paused. Before then, use a free skip.

How do I cancel?

Tap cancel in My Yard. There is no contract and no phone call. If you signed up with the Black Friday sale, keep your plan for 60 days and your free month stays free. If you cancel in your first 60 days, we charge one month at your plan price, minus anything you have paid.

What if I get another dog?

Text us, or we will see on our next visit. We update your plan to match and email you the new price. It starts with your next bill. Each dog after two adds $13 a month, or $9 on the every other week plan.

What is My Yard?

My Yard is your account on our site. Sign in with your email and a 6 digit code. No password. You can see your next visits, skip a visit, pause, see your bills and gate photos, change your card, or cancel.

Is my card safe?

Yes. You pay through Stripe, the same checkout big stores use. Stripe keeps your card. We never see or store your card number.

How do I see my bills?

Sign in to My Yard. Every bill is there, and you can open or save each one.

My yard is rock, not grass.

Rock can hide poop. So we rake rock yards with a wide metal rake.
